context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 断固/刻ま/在学/将校/忠誠/一変/苦難/体格

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、断固たる、平和への姿勢、本当に、印象的でしたね、桜さん、本気で、立派な、研究、できましたね、絶対。
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on the firm stance toward peace was truly striking. The research itself is splendid — genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Clear enunciation on key words. Steady eye contact, unhurried pace. The tone of someone who has read carefully and wants her to know it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史に刻まれた事件、論文で、丁寧に、扱いました、本当に、深い、研究、できました、本気で、感謝、しております。
lines.en: Yes. I handled the historical events carved into our collective memory with care in the paper. I was able to do genuinely deep research, and I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Respectful but with quiet confidence. Measured cadence. Slight pause before acknowledging gratitude — not performative, but sincere. She meets the praise without deflecting, but doesn't oversell it either.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、在学中の学生、徴兵された歴史、論文で、扱っていましたね、桜さん、本当に、辛い、内容、でしたよね、本気で。
lines.en: You addressed the drafting of students during wartime — the conscription itself — and that was difficult subject matter to handle. You did it with real care.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly somber. Slower pace when touching on the war's weight. Genuine respect in her voice. Not looking away from the hardness of the topic. A pause before continuing, as if honoring what Sakura researched.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。将校の記録、丁寧に、論文に、引用しました、本気で、貴重な、史料、本当に、深い、研究、できました、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I carefully cited officer records in the paper. Those were precious historical documents, and I was able to conduct genuinely deep research with them.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the work done. Precise, deliberate delivery — she's proud of the research method. Not breathless, but grounded. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' and 'precious,' showing she understands their weight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 忠誠という概念、戦時、市民にも、求められた歴史、本気で、扱っていましたね、桜さん、視野、本当に、広いです、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The concept of loyalty — how it was demanded not just of soldiers but of ordinary citizens during wartime. You examined that with real depth. Your perspective is genuinely broad.
lines.style: Engaged and nodding slightly. More animated than before, but still measured. Voice rises with genuine interest on 'concept of loyalty.' Recognition that Sakura saw something many wouldn't. Warm and approving.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦後、文化が、本気で、一変、しましたよね、論文の重要な、テーマでした、絶対、深い、研究、できました、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. How culture transformed so completely after the war — that was one of the crucial themes of my paper. I was able to research it deeply, and I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment. She understands the import of what she's saying. Steadier now, less apologetic. A slight lift at the end — not relief, but recognition of completion. Respectful of the scope she covered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、戦後の苦難、人々の、生き様、論文で、丁寧に、論じていましたね、本当に、感動的、桜さん、本気で、立派、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: The hardships of wartime and after, the way people endured and lived through it — you examined all that carefully in your paper. It was genuinely moving, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, more contemplative. Slower pace. Real emotion underneath — she's not performing but sharing what the paper affected in her. Gentle conviction. The tone of someone humbled by witnessing honest work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦中の体格、栄養不足の、影響、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、できました、本当に、感謝、しております、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I addressed the physical toll of wartime — malnutrition and its effects on the population — in the paper. I was able to conduct genuinely deep research on it, and I'm truly, truly grateful.
lines.style: Calm but with underlying emotion. Double emphasis on 'truly' — exhaustion and gratitude mixed. She's reaching the end of the presentation, slight catch in her voice. Not breaking, but genuine. The weight of what she's researched settling on her.
